clues: A milestone event in the life of a young girl
It usually occurs at about 12 to 13 years of age
It is the first menstrual period
A visible change that is often the earliest sign of puberty in girls
It is the start of breast development
It is driven by ovarian estrogen and is called the breast bud stage
A maturation event that happens before true puberty
The adrenal cortex starts making more androgens such as DHEAS
It occurs at about 6 to 8 years and causes pubic and axillary hair
A small peptide made by hypothalamic neurones
Its pulsatile release at puberty stimulates the pituitary to secrete LH and FSH
It is also called gonadotropin-releasing hormone
A scoring system used by doctors on adolescents
It rates breast, genital and pubic hair development from 1 to 5
Stage 1 is prepubertal and stage 5 is adult
